cases.title: Survey required only once after new profile creation
cases.preconditions: WireMock mock backend is running; no prior preferences for a new profile.
steps: POST /v1/profile to create a new profile
cases.expectedResult: After profile creation surveyRequired=true. After saving preferences surveyRequired=false. A repeated onboarding-status check still returns surveyRequired=false (survey shown only once).

cases.title: POST vod-preferences persists exact genreIds and movieIds
cases.preconditions: Profile exists (e.g. profile-personalized). WireMock records request bodies.
steps: Verify WireMock received the exact JSON body
cases.expectedResult: POST returns 200 with saved=true and skipped=false. Request body contains the exact genre and movie IDs submitted. GET returns the same genreIds and movieIds as saved preferences.

cases.title: Skip survey via API and receive default recommendations
cases.expectedResult: POST returns 200 with skipped=true. Recommendations return source=default and a non-empty itemIds list.

cases.title: Personalized recommendations after saved preferences
cases.preconditions: Profile profile-personalized has mock state representing completed survey.
cases.expectedResult: HTTP 200; source=personalized; itemIds include saved movie IDs [101,102,103,104,105].

cases.title: Save preferences then recommendations reflect saved data
steps: POST /v1/profile/{profileId}/vod-preferences with valid genreIds and movieIds
cases.expectedResult: POST succeeds. Subsequent GET recommendations returns source=personalized with itemIds aligned to saved preferences (count and values per mock contract).

cases.title: Reject preferences with fewer than 3 genres (1 or 2 genreIds)
cases.expectedResult: Both requests return HTTP 400 with error=MIN_GENRES_REQUIRED; preferences are not saved.

cases.title: Unknown profile returns 404 on vod-preferences
cases.preconditions: Profile ID is not registered in mock (profile-unknown).

cases.title: Next button disabled with zero genres selected
steps: Observe Next button without selecting any genre
cases.expectedResult: Selected genre count is 0. Next button is disabled.

cases.title: Next button disabled with one genre selected
cases.expectedResult: Selected genre count is 1. Next button remains disabled.
cases.automationNotes: Gap: add ui.tests test mirroring 2-genre case with selectGenres(1)

cases.title: Next button disabled with two genres selected
Next button enabled with three genres selected
Next button enabled with four genres selected
Next button disabled again after dropping below 3 genres
steps: Select 3 genres and confirm Next is enabled
Uncheck one genre to leave 2 selected
cases.expectedResult: Next button becomes disabled when selected count is below 3.

cases.title: Movies step appears after 3 genres and Next
cases.expectedResult: Genre step is hidden. Movies step is visible.

cases.title: Movie list filtered by selected genres
steps: Select genre combination A (e.g. indexes 0,1,2) and click Next
Return to genre step, select different combination B (e.g. 0,1,3) and click Next
cases.expectedResult: Visible movies on step 2 depend on selected genres; different genre sets produce different filtered lists.

cases.title: Finish disabled when fewer than 5 movies selected
cases.preconditions: User is on movies step (3 genres selected, Next clicked).
steps: On movies step with 0 movies selected, check Finish
cases.expectedResult: Finish remains disabled until exactly 5 movies are selected.
cases.automationNotes: Partial in SurveyFlowUiTest.userCanSelectFiveMoviesAndFinish (asserts disabled before 5); extend for explicit 4-movie case

cases.title: Finish enabled when exactly 5 movies selected
cases.expectedResult: Selected movie count is 5. Finish button is enabled.

cases.title: Skip dismisses survey without completing preferences
cases.preconditions: Survey fixture loaded on genre step.
cases.expectedResult: Genre step is hidden. Skipped confirmation state is shown. (Default recommendations validated at API layer.)

cases.title: End-to-end: new profile, complete survey via API, personalized recommendations
cases.preconditions: Mock backend; client can call profile, preferences, and recommendations APIs.
steps: POST vod-preferences with 3 genres and 5 movies
cases.expectedResult: Onboarding shows survey once. Saved genre/movie IDs are accepted. Recommendations return personalized source after completion.
cases.automationNotes: Compose ProfileOnboardingApiTest + RecommendationsApiTest; full browser E2E optional future work
